intuition: Maintain a window with unique characters; when a repeated character appears, move the left edge past its previous occurrence.

brute_force.approach: Check every substring and test whether its characters are unique.

optimal.approach: Track each character's most recent index and move the left boundary forward only when that occurrence is inside the current window.

edge_cases: An empty string has answer zero.
Repeated adjacent characters reduce the window to one character.
A previous occurrence before the current window must not move the left boundary backward.
